package.name: nros_zenoh_tools
package.description:
The `router` command (RFC-0119 D8): `nros router config` prints the zenoh router `downsampling` rule `nros sync` wrote beside a resolved model, ready for `ZENOH_CONFIG_OVERRIDE`. It replaces the built-in `nros ws router-config`, which stays as a hidden alias that executes this package.
A command package of the same shape as a user's: the announcement below is what the provider scan reads, and `nros-command.toml` is read only when this provider is the one selected.
